risk_summary: The excerpt provides meaningful quantitative disclosure on debt, availability, covenants, letters of credit, and capital leases, but relies heavily on standard forward-looking disclaimers and judgment-based accounting language. Key risks include leverage, refinancing and interest-rate exposure, goodwill and intangible-asset impairment, self-insurance estimates, tax uncertainty, and possible changes in vendor return policies.
